    • getLastDamage

      double getLastDamage()
      Returns the living entity's last damage taken in the current no damage ticks time. 返回该生物实体在当前无伤害时间段内最后受到的伤害。

      Only damage higher than this amount will further damage the living entity. 只有高于此数值的伤害才能进一步伤害该生物实体。

      返回:
      damage taken since the last no damage ticks time period 自上一个无伤害时间段以来受到的伤害

    • addPotionEffect

      boolean addPotionEffect(PotionEffect effect)
      Adds the given PotionEffect to the living entity. 将给定的 PotionEffect 添加到该生物实体。

      whether the effect could be added 该效果能否被添加

    • addPotionEffect

      boolean addPotionEffect(PotionEffect effect, boolean force)
      Adds the given PotionEffect to the living entity. 将给定的 PotionEffect 添加到该生物实体。

    • hasLineOfSight

      boolean hasLineOfSight(Entity other)
      Checks whether the living entity has block line of sight to another. 检查该生物实体是否与另一实体之间存在方块视线。

      This uses the same algorithm that hostile mobs use to find the closest player. 这使用与敌对生物寻找最近玩家相同的算法。

      参数:
      other - the entity to determine line of sight to 要确定视线目标的实体
      返回:
      true if there is a line of sight, false if not 若存在视线则为 true，否则为 false

    • getRemoveWhenFarAway

      boolean getRemoveWhenFarAway()
      Returns if the living entity despawns when away from players or not. 返回该生物实体在远离玩家时是否会消失。

      By default, animals are not removed while other mobs are. 默认情况下，动物不会被移除，而其他生物会。

      返回:
      true if the living entity is removed when away from players 若该生物实体在远离玩家时被移除则为 true

    • setRemoveWhenFarAway

    • setLeashHolder

      boolean setLeashHolder(Entity holder)
      Sets the leash on this entity to be held by the supplied entity. 将该实体的拴绳设置为由给定实体持有。

      This method has no effect on EnderDragons, Withers, Players, or Bats. Non-living entities excluding leashes will not persist as leash holders. 此方法对末影龙、凋灵、玩家或蝙蝠无效。除拴绳外的非生物实体不会作为拴绳持有者持久保存。

      参数:
      holder - the entity to leash this entity to 要将该实体拴到的实体
      返回:
      whether the operation was successful 操作是否成功
